name: EffectCraft
description: EffectCraft is an open-source motion graphics and compositing tool written from scratch in pure Rust by the ArtCraft team. It ships as a native universal macOS app (DMG and Homebrew cask) and also runs on Windows and Linux. Like all Crafting Apps it is young and moving fast: v0.13.0 landed in October 2026.

zh.description: EffectCraft 是 ArtCraft 团队从零开始、用纯 Rust 编写的开源动效图形与合成工具。提供 macOS universal 原生版本（DMG 与 Homebrew cask），同时支持 Windows 和 Linux。和所有 Crafting Apps 一样年轻而迭代飞快：v0.13.0 于 2026 年 10 月发布。

body.en: EffectCraft is the ArtCraft family's open-source motion graphics and compositing tool, written from scratch in pure Rust.
body.zh: EffectCraft 是 ArtCraft 家族的开源动效图形与合成工具，从零开始用纯 Rust 编写。

body.en: It ships as a native universal macOS app (DMG and Homebrew cask) alongside Windows and Linux builds. Development moves fast — v0.13.0 landed in October 2026.
body.zh: macOS 提供 universal 原生版本（DMG 与 Homebrew cask），同时有 Windows 和 Linux 构建。迭代很快——v0.13.0 于 2026 年 10 月发布。
